title: Stickman Typing tutor - Do i add more enemies?
author: Disastrous-Analyst85
selftext:
Hi , first time posting and publishing a game on Itch io

Made one with the concept Stickman fights and typing equals combos

Press tab for settings where you can select letters, words or sentences

Press 1,2,3,4 for ultimate's (4 uses all bars)

  
Question do i add more enemies or is it enough for beginners?

  
here is the link if anyone is interested [https://inkfight.itch.io/inkfight-typing-tutor](https://inkfight.itch.io/inkfight-typing-tutor)
